title: Use the food already at home
brief: I waste groceries because I cannot see what is in my pantry or turn it into a simple weeknight plan.

target_population.role: budget-conscious home cook feeding a family of four on weeknights
target_population.coverage_limit: one household pantry; no barcode scanning or store integrations

core_task.summary: add a pantry item and generate a plan that uses what expires soonest
core_task.success_oracle: adding a pantry item and pressing plan produces a three-night plan whose first night uses the soonest-expiring seeded ingredient

not_applicable_states.loading: the pantry is a seeded local dataset read synchronously and planning is an in-memory sort, so no state ever waits on a fetch or long computation

state_recipes.empty: open the /plan route before generating any plan; the empty plan panel explains the next action instead of a blank region
state_recipes.validation-error: submit the add-item form with a blank name or a zero quantity; an inline error names the offending field
state_recipes.success: add rolled oats then press the plan button; the three-night plan renders with night one using the expiring chickpeas
state_recipes.focus: press Tab from page load until the item-name field shows its visible focus ring
state_recipes.mobile: load either route at 390x844; the add form collapses above the pantry list

acceptance_facts: The seeded pantry holds twelve staples and the soonest expiry is the canned chickpeas dated 2026-08-18.
Generating a plan yields exactly three weeknight dinners and night one uses the expiring chickpeas.
Before any plan exists the plan panel states what to do next instead of rendering an unexplained blank area.

product_signature.mechanism: expiry-first planner that sorts the pantry queue into named weeknights
product_signature.anchor: three-night rail on the plan route
product_signature.brief_trace: turn what is in my pantry into a simple weeknight plan
product_signature.counterfactual: a bare inventory table would serve a stocktake brief but cannot answer what to cook tonight
product_signature.task_proof: success capture shows night one citing the chickpeas that expire on 2026-08-18

anti_goals: no recipe API, web import, or photo recognition
no nutrition scoring or dietary health claims
no grocery ordering or delivery integration

content_seed.data_notes: twelve seeded staples total; the six listed here fix the expiry ordering the planner must respect
